     Me!Traccia.Enabled = True

End Sub
Private Sub Anno_Change()
     Me!Data = ""
     Me!Data.Requery
          
     Me!Traccia.Enabled = False
     'Me!Piadatradizionale500.Enabled = False
     Me!ricercapiadaolio.Enabled = False
     'Me!Meraviglie.Enabled = False
    ' Me!P360FDB.Enabled = False
     'Me!YUKYUK.Enabled = False
     Me!P5Cereali.Enabled = False
    ' Me!SalutiRiccione.Enabled = False
    ' Me!P600FDB.Enabled = False
     
     
End Sub

Private Sub Snapshot_Click()


Dim NomeReport As String
Dim NomeFile As String
Dim strpercorso As String

    NomeReport = "TraccabilitàdaData"
    NomeFile = "Lotto" & Left(Me.Data, 10) & "-" & Year(Now)
    strpercorso = Me!SMPercorso!PercorsoSnapshot & "\Lotti\" & NomeFile & ".snp"
    DoCmd.OutputTo acOutputReport, NomeReport, "SnapshotFormat", strpercorso, False
    'DoCmd.OutputTo acReport, "Ordini", "SnapshotFormat", "\\hl\i di hl\archiviosrl\dati\ordini\prova.snp", False, ""


   ' Dim strOutputFormat As String

    'strOutputFormat = "SnapshotFormat"

'DoCmd.OutputTo acOutputReport, NomeReport, strOutputFormat, strpercorso



End Sub
